select distinct A.TOTLE_TRADE_ID as tradeId, A.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, C.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, C.FINPROD_MARKET_ID marketId, C.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodAbbr, C.PROFIT_TYPE as profitType, A.TRADE_DATE as confirmDate, A.SETTLE_DATE as cashDate, A.PS as dealType, C.CCY as ccy, fpa.IS_CYCLE as isCycle, fpa.IS_LAY as isLay, (CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPRG} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPSG} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END)as tdyBuyMoney,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPRG} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPSG} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END) as tdyBuyQty,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQZZ} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPWYSH} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQSH} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END) as tdyRedMoney,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQZZ} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPWYSH} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQSH} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END) as tdyRedQty,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPHLZT} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END) as tdyCarriedMoney,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPHLZT} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END) as tdyCarriedQty,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_ZJFX} THEN A.TRADE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_XJFH} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END) as bonusCash,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN A.RED_COST WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN A.RED_COST WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQZZ} THEN A.RED_COST WHEN #{JYFX_CPWYSH} THEN A.RED_COST WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQSH} THEN A.RED_COST ELSE 0 END) as redCost,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN A.RED_PROFIT WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN A.RED_PROFIT WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQZZ} THEN A.RED_PROFIT WHEN #{JYFX_CPWYSH} THEN A.RED_PROFIT WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQSH} THEN A.RED_PROFIT ELSE 0 END) as redInt,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQZ} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END) as tdyForceIncreaseMoney,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQZ} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END) as tdyForceIncreaseQty,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQJ} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END) as tdyForceReduceMoney,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQJ} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) ESLE 0 END) as tdyForceReduceQty,
(CASE WHEN TPDA.GEN_TYPE ='01' THEN '接口接入' WHEN '03' THEN '批处理生成' ELSE '画面录入' END) as genType,
(CASE WHEN A.IS_CANCEL = 'Y' THEN '03' ESLE '01' END) effectStatus,
A.REMARK as dealRemark from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL A inner join FIN_PRODUCT C on A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID and C.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_SY} left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa on C.FINPROD_ID = fpa.FINPROD_ID left join PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL B on A.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = B.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT PFP on C.FINPROD_ID = PFP.FINPROD_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal on A.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA
on deal.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID
where C.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_LCCP}
and A.PS not in (#{JYFX_CPCQDJ},#{JYFX_CPFF},#{JYFX_SFJN})
AND IFNULL(A.P_TRADE_ID, 'null') = 'null' /*add by zhangweiqi 2019-3-27 过滤撤销记录*/
and A.IS_CANCEL =(CASE WHEN #{effectStatus} ='03' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END)
AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
AND fpa.PROD_MANAGER IN
#{item}
AND A.FINPROD_ID IN
#{item}
AND fpa.DEAL_MODE = #{dealMode}
AND A.SETTLE_DATE >= str_to_date(#{cashDateBegin}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.SETTLE_DATE <= str_to_date(#{cashDateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.TRADE_DATE >= str_to_date(#{confirmDateBegin}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.TRADE_DATE <= str_to_date(#{confirmDateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and A.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUserName})
AND A.PS = #{dealType}
AND C.CCY = #{ccy}
group by A.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, A.PORTFOLIO_ID, C.FINPROD_ABBR, C.PROFIT_TYPE,C.FINPROD_ID, C.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, A.PROD_ID, A.TRADE_DATE, fpa.SALE_DEPARTMENT, C.CCY, fpa.IS_LAY, A.TRADE_AMT, A.SHARE_AMT, A.RED_COST, A.RED_PROFIT, fpa.IS_CYCLE, A.SETTLE_DATE, A.PS, TPDA.GEN_TYPE,A.IS_CANCEL,A.PRIN_AMT,A.INT_AMT, A.REMARK
union all
select distinct A.TOTLE_TRADE_ID as tradeId, A.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, C.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, C.FINPROD_MARKET_ID marketId, C.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodAbbr, C.PROFIT_TYPE as profitType, A.TRADE_DATE as confirmDate, A.SETTLE_DATE as cashDate, A.PS as dealType, C.CCY as ccy, fpa.IS_CYCLE as isCycle, fpa.IS_LAY as isLay, (CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPRG} THEN A.TRADE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPSG} THEN A.TRADE_AMT ELSE 0 END) as tdyBuyMoney,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPRG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPSG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END) as tdyBuyQty,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQZZ} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPWYSH} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQSH} THEN IFNULL(A.TRADE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END) as tdyRedMoney,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQZZ} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPWYSH} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQSH} THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) ELSE 0 END) as tdyRedQty,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPHLZT} THEN A.TRADE_AMT ELSE 0 END) as tdyCarriedMoney,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPHLZT} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END) as tdyCarriedQty,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_ZJFX} THEN A.TRADE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_XJFH} THEN A.TRADE_AMT ELSE 0 END) as bonusCash,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN A.RED_COST WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN A.RED_COST WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQZZ} THEN A.RED_COST WHEN #{JYFX_CPWYSH} THEN A.RED_COST WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQSH} THEN (CASE WHEN C.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_JZ} THEN A.RED_COST ELSE A.PRIN_AMT END) ELSE 0 END) as redCost,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN A.RED_PROFIT WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN A.RED_PROFIT WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQZZ} THEN A.RED_PROFIT WHEN #{JYFX_CPWYSH} THEN A.RED_PROFIT WHEN #{JYFX_CPTQSH} THEN (CASE WHEN C.PROFIT_TYPE = #{PROFIT_TYPE_JZ} THEN A.RED_PROFIT ELSE A.INT_AMT END) ELSE 0 END) as redInt,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQZ} THEN A.TRADE_AMT ELSE 0 END) as tdyForceIncreaseMoney,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQZ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END) as tdyForceIncreaseQty,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQJ} THEN A.TRADE_AMT ELSE 0 END) as tdyForceReduceMoney,
(CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQJ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END) as tdyForceReduceQty,
(CASE WHEN TPDA.GEN_TYPE ='01' THEN '接口接入' WHEN '03' THEN '批处理生成' ELSE '画面录入' END) as genType,
(CASE WHEN A.IS_CANCEL = 'Y' THEN '03' ELSE '01' END) effectStatus,
A.REMARK as dealRemark
from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL A inner join FIN_PRODUCT C on A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID and C.PROFIT_TYPE <> #{PROFIT_TYPE_SY} left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa on C.FINPROD_ID = fpa.FINPROD_ID left join PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL B on A.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = B.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT PFP on C.FINPROD_ID = PFP.FINPROD_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL deal on A.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA
on deal.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID
where C.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_LCCP}
and A.PS not in (#{JYFX_CPCQDJ},#{JYFX_CPFF},#{JYFX_SFJN})
AND IFNULL(A.P_TRADE_ID, 'null') = 'null' /*add by zhangweiqi 2019-3-27 过滤撤销记录*/
and A.IS_CANCEL =(CASE WHEN #{effectStatus} = '03' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END)
AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
AND fpa.PROD_MANAGER IN
#{item}
AND A.FINPROD_ID IN
#{item}
AND fpa.DEAL_MODE = #{dealMode}
AND A.SETTLE_DATE >= str_to_date(#{cashDateBegin}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.SETTLE_DATE <= str_to_date(#{cashDateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.TRADE_DATE >= str_to_date(#{confirmDateBegin}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.TRADE_DATE <= str_to_date(#{confirmDateEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and A.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUserName})
AND A.PS = #{dealType}
AND C.CCY = #{ccy}
group by A.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, A.PORTFOLIO_ID, C.FINPROD_ABBR, C.PROFIT_TYPE,C.FINPROD_ID, C.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, A.PROD_ID, A.TRADE_DATE, fpa.SALE_DEPARTMENT, C.CCY, fpa.IS_LAY, A.TRADE_AMT, A.SHARE_AMT, A.RED_COST, A.RED_PROFIT, fpa.IS_CYCLE, A.SETTLE_DATE, A.PS,TPDA.GEN_TYPE,A.IS_CANCEL,A.PRIN_AMT,A.INT_AMT, A.REMARK order by portfolioId, finprodId, confirmDate

select A.BRANCH as sonProdId, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPRG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPSG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END )) as tdyBuyMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPRG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPSG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyBuyQty, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyRedMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyRedQty, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_ZJFX} THEN A.TRADE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyCarriedInterest, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPHLZT} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyCarriedMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQZ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceIncreaseMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQZ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceIncreaseQty, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQJ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceReduceMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQJ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceReduceQty from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A where A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and (A.IS_CANCEL is null OR A.IS_CANCEL = #{IS_CANCEL_N}) and (A.TRADE_STATUS IS NULL OR A.TRADE_STATUS != #{TRADE_STATUS_03}) and A.TRADE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cashDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') group by A.BRANCH

select A.BRANCH as sonProdId, C.CUSTOM_LEVEL as customLevel, C.AMT_MAX as amtMax, C.AMT_MIN as amtMin, C.TERM_MAX as termMax, C.TERM_MIN as termMin, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPRG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPSG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END )) as tdyBuyMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPRG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPSG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyBuyQty, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyRedMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyRedQty, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_ZJFX} THEN A.TRADE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyCarriedInterest, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPHLZT} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyCarriedMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQZ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceIncreaseMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQZ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceIncreaseQty, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQJ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceReduceMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQJ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceReduceQty from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A left join FIN_PRODUCT B on A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID left join PRD_LAYER_PARAM C on A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID where B.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and (A.IS_CANCEL is null OR A.IS_CANCEL = #{IS_CANCEL_N}) and (A.TRADE_STATUS IS NULL OR A.TRADE_STATUS != #{TRADE_STATUS_03}) and A.TRADE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cashDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') group by A.BRANCH, C.CUSTOM_LEVEL, C.AMT_MAX, C.AMT_MIN, C.TERM_MAX, C.TERM_MIN order by A.BRANCH

select A.BRANCH as sonProdId, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPRG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPSG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END )) as tdyBuyMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPRG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPSG} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyBuyQty, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyRedMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPSH} THEN A.SHARE_AMT WHEN #{JYFX_CPDQ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyRedQty, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_ZJFX} THEN A.TRADE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyCarriedInterest, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_CPHLZT} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyCarriedMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQZ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceIncreaseMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQZ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceIncreaseQty, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQJ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceReduceMoney, sum((CASE WHEN A.PS = #{JYFX_FEQJ} THEN A.SHARE_AMT ELSE 0 END)) as tdyForceReduceQty from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A where A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and (A.IS_CANCEL is null OR A.IS_CANCEL = #{IS_CANCEL_N}) and (A.TRADE_STATUS IS NULL OR A.TRADE_STATUS != #{TRADE_STATUS_03}) and A.TRADE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{cashDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') group by A.BRANCH

select A.PRODID, A.CDATE, A.PRODNAME, A.CCY, A.STARTDATE, A.ENDDATE, A.ACTENDDATE, A.NETVALUE, A.PREINAMOUNT, A.TOTALCURRENTAMOUNT, A.TOTALBUYAMOUNT, A.TOTALDRAWAMOUNT, A.TOTALDRAWCUSTAMOUNT, A.TOTALFEESAMOUNT, A.TOTALCARRIEDINTEREST, A.TOTALNOTCARRIEDINTEREST, A.RESERVEBUYAMT, A.RESERVEDRAWVOL, A.TOTALCARRIEDVOL, A.TOTALPAYABLEINTEREST, A.TOTALNEWINTEREST, A.TOTALCLOSEINTEREST, A.TOTALCARRYINTEREST, A.TOTALCURRENTQUANTITY, A.TOTALBUYQUANTITY, A.TOTALDRAWQUANTITY, A.TOTALCOUNT, A.TOTALPROFITAMOUNT, A.PRODTYPE, A.PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE, A.INTERF_ID, A.CREATE_TIME, B.FINPROD_ID as finprodId,
DATE_FORMAT(B.MDATE, '%Y%m%d') as prodMdate, C.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId,
C.PROD_REGIST_CODE as prodRegistCode, D.BRANCHID as branchId, D.BRANCHBUYAMOUNT as branchbuyamount, D.BRANCHBUYNUM as branchbuynum from INTERF_PROD_INFO A left join FIN_PRODUCT B on A.PRODID = B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C on B.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID left join INTERF_BRANCH D on A.PRODID = D.PRODID where A.CDATE = #{platDate}
and A.CDATE > DATE_FORMAT(B.VDATE, '%Y%m%d')
